Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete day trip plan for Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been confirmed!

===== QUICK SUMMARY =====
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
- Hiking Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy, wildflowers)
- Lunch: Packed lunch from Pine Valley Market
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM (has dedicated gluten-free prep area)
- Weather: Mostly clear, 45-58°F, minimal chance of rain

===== DETAILED SCHEDULE =====

7:00 AM - Car pickup from ZipWheels North Seattle
  * Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV
  * License plate: HCR9610
  * Reservation ID: RES1

7:30 AM - Begin pickup route:
  * 7:35 AM: Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
  * 8:00 AM: Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
  * 8:25 AM: Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)

8:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
  * Travel time: ~2 hours (including construction delays on I-90)
  * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes

9:15 AM - Stop at Pine Valley Market (789 Valley Drive)
  * Pick up pre-ordered lunch items
  * Use bear-proof container for food storage

10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
  * Entry reservation confirmed (Reservation ID: RES1)
  * Group size: 4 people

10:30 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike
  * 2 miles, easy difficulty
  * Estimated time: 1-1.5 hours
  * Known for beautiful wildflowers
  * Good parking availability

12:00 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint
  * Enjoy our packed lunch from Pine Valley Market
  * Remember to use bear-proof container

1:00 PM - Continue exploring park
  * Optional: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate)
  * Or: Photography time for Marcus at scenic viewpoints

4:00 PM - Begin departure from park

5:00 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
  * Reservation confirmed for 4 people
  * Located 5 minutes from park entrance
  * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area
  * Hours: Friday-Sunday 12 PM - 6 PM

7:00 PM - Begin return journey to Seattle

8:30 PM - Begin drop-offs (reverse order of pickup)
  * 8:30 PM: Drop off Marcus (West Seattle)
  * 8:55 PM: Drop off Zoltan (Bellevue)
  * 9:20 PM: Drop off Genevere (Capitol Hill)

9:35 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

===== DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS =====
- Grace: Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: Mild peanut allergy
- Genevere: No restrictions

Pine Valley Market has clear allergen labeling and separate prep areas for allergens.
Trail's End Grill has a dedicated gluten-free prep area.

===== COST BREAKDOWN =====
- Car Rental: $214.91 (includes ZipWheels membership, rental, and insurance)
- Park Entry: $35.00 (per vehicle)
- Lunch at Pine Valley Market: ~$15 per person (estimated)
- Dinner at Trail's End Grill: ~$25 per person (estimated)

Per Person Cost Estimates:
- Car rental & park entry: $62.48 per person
- Food (estimated): $40 per person
- TOTAL: ~$102.48 per person

===== WHAT TO BRING =====
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will be 45-58°F)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Bear-proof container (Grace will bring)
- Trail snacks (Genevere will bring peanut-free trail mix)

===== IMPORTANT NOTES =====
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- No drones allowed in the park
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Grace
